name: Cairo (Egypt)
description: Divided horizontally white over slate blue, charged with a blue-ringed white disc bearing the Mosque of Muhammad Ali in dark red.
history: The earlier emblem flag of Cairo — a light blue field defaced with a brown stylised silhouette of the Citadel of Saladin and the mosques of Islamic Cairo. It long served as the flag of the Cairo Governorate (which is coterminous with the city of Cairo) before the governorate adopted the redesigned golden-sun emblem in 2010.
